description: Down off the wall, and no glass

participation.context: Wrote, struck one line, and put the pen down before the leaf was full.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You kept the king on the ground, struck out the glass, and wrote that he is not yet in the room. You did not start the next scene.
topics: the empty half of the leaf

title: Crossed out the order to send for a glass

description: Three names, and the glass still out

participation.context: Wrote the page and did not start another sheet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the three names on the page, kept the glass as a promise not yet in a room, and wrote that the precept had not arrived.

title: Wrote the three marks and the glass off the sheet
